subject: UX spec final review: Console Guided Onboarding Checklist (v0.9) — approval + last copy/order tweaks
related_links: Linear: DES-115 (docs deep links + UTM conventions)
body:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 12, 2026 at 9:14 AM PT
Subject: UX spec final review: Console Guided Onboarding Checklist (v0.9) — approval + last copy/order tweaks

Hi all — sharing the v0.9 UX spec for the guided onboarding checklist (Console) for final review.

What’s new since last review:
- Locked pattern: persistent right-rail checklist on key Console pages (no modal). Collapses to a single “Get started” card on narrow widths.
- Step states & visuals: Not started / In progress / Complete / Needs attention (error state w/ deep link).
- Deep-link behavior: “Open docs” is always a secondary action; primary action stays in-product when available.
- Accessibility: keyboard navigation, focus order, and screen reader labels included.

Open items I need final input on today:
1) Step ordering (see pg 7): I’m proposing we move “Create API key” ahead of “Install SDK” so the quickstart copy can assume a key exists.
2) Copy: whether to say “Production” vs “Live” in the checklist title and the final step.

Attachments:
- console-guided-onboarding-ux-spec-v0.9.pdf
- checklist-copy-pack-v0.9.docx

If we can get sign-off by EOD, I’ll mark the spec final and hand off to Console eng for build.

Thanks,
Tessa
Head of Product Design
Redwood Inference


---

From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 12, 2026 at 10:03 AM PT
Subject: Re: UX spec final review: Console Guided Onboarding Checklist (v0.9) — approval + last copy/order tweaks

Reviewed — overall looks good.

Two docs-related notes (copy + IA):
1) Terminology consistency
- In the spec and copy pack we bounce between “project” and “workspace” in a couple places (ex: “first request for this workspace”). Our docs pages consistently use “project.” Recommend we standardize on “project” everywhere in Console UI for this flow.

2) Deep links and analytics
- For the docs deep links, we should keep the anchor text stable (“Open docs”) and vary attribution via UTM params rather than changing CTA labels by step.
- Proposed format: utm_source=console&utm_medium=checklist&utm_campaign=guided_onboarding&utm_content=<step_id>

Re: step ordering
- +1 to moving “Create API key” first. Every support thread we saw starts with auth failures; this reduces confusion.

Re: production wording
- My suggestion: avoid “Production” in the header; keep it in the final step title only (“Launch to production”), with a short tooltip definition.

Elliot
Director, Technical Documentation


---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 12, 2026 at 11:26 AM PT
Subject: Re: UX spec final review: Console Guided Onboarding Checklist (v0.9) — approval + last copy/order tweaks

+1 to the right-rail pattern. It’s the least disruptive and works with the rollouts dashboard.

On step ordering: a few tweaks from the Console side (mostly to reduce “dead ends”):
- Step 1: Create API key (Test)
- Step 2: Make your first request (keep this early; it’s the dopamine hit)
- Step 3: Install SDK (optional step; don’t block progress)
- Step 4: Stream a response (validate via first streaming session)
- Step 5: Handle errors & retries (links to docs + quickstart snippet)
- Step 6: Understand rate limits & quotas (links to quota UI + 429 guidance)
- Step 7: View usage & latency in Console (dash visit validation)
- Step 8: Create a Production API key
- Step 9: Launch to production (links to the long-form checklist doc; this one should be manual completion initially)

Copy suggestions:
- Please avoid “prod-mode” in user-facing text. Use “Production API key.”
- For Step 9 description: call out “timeouts + retries + monitoring + rollback plan” as the minimum. (We can keep the expanded list in docs.)

Small UI detail:
- The “Needs attention” state: can we label it “Action needed” instead? It reads less scary.

Assuming these changes, I’m good to sign off.

Marissa
PM, Console & Rollouts


---

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 12, 2026 at 1:02 PM PT
Subject: Re: UX spec final review: Console Guided Onboarding Checklist (v0.9) — approval + last copy/order tweaks

Looks solid — approving contingent on the following updates (agree with Marissa/Elliot):

1) Terminology
- Standardize on “project” throughout.

2) Step order + framing
- I’m aligned with the reordered flow Marissa proposed.
- Keep “Install SDK” optional (we still need curl examples, and some users will do direct REST calls).

3) Copy guardrails
- No “prod-mode” phrasing.
- Replace “Needs attention” with “Action needed.”
- Checklist header: “Get started” or “Guided onboarding” (avoid “Production” in the title).

4) Definition tooltip for production
- Add a one-line definition on the final step: “Production = customer-facing traffic and/or reliability expectations (alerts, retries, rollback).” Keep it simple.

Once you incorporate these, mark v1.0 and please send a short note to Dylan/Chloe’s team with the final step IDs (so telemetry and docs UTMs don’t drift).

Alex
VP, Developer Experience


---

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 12, 2026 at 4:48 PM PT
Subject: Re: UX spec final review: Console Guided Onboarding Checklist (v0.9) — approval + last copy/order tweaks

Done — incorporated all requested changes and marked the spec v1.0.

Changes applied:
- Reordered steps to Marissa’s sequence; “Install SDK” labeled optional and not required for progress.
- Terminology standardized to “project” across spec + copy.
- Updated state label: “Action needed” (replaces “Needs attention”).
- Removed “prod-mode” wording; using “Production API key.”
- Header updated to “Guided onboarding” (no “Production” in the title).
- Added final-step tooltip definition for “Production” (simple, 1 line).
- Docs deep links: adopted Elliot’s stable CTA + UTM format; step attribution via utm_content=<step_id>.

Next:
- I’ll email Console eng (Dylan/Chloe) separately with the final step IDs + strings so telemetry/doc linking stays stable.

Thanks everyone for fast turnaround.

Tessa
Head of Product Design
Redwood Inference
